question: 查询最近30天的有效订单数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
description: 统计最近30天的有效订单（已支付或已完成）

question: 计算本月GMV
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01')
description: 计算本月的GMV（成交总额），只统计有效订单

question: 查询各商品类目的销售排行
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) as total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
description: 按商品类目统计销售数量和收入，按收入降序排列

question: 查询退款率最高的商品
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) as refund_count, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) as order_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id), 2) as refund_rate FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY p.id HAVING order_count > 0 ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 10
description: 计算退款率最高的前10个商品，退款率 = 退款订单数 / 总订单数

question: 查询用户复购情况
sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, MIN(created_at) as first_order, MAX(created_at) as last_order FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC
description: 查询有复购行为的用户，统计订单数和首末订单时间
